title: Asset Store in editor: Request failed, return code 500 (Godot 4.7.2)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.2.stable.official (ed1daf0bf)
- Also reproducible with the Steam build of Godot Engine (same 4.7.2.stable.official)

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable.official - Pop!_OS 24.04 (Linux 6.18.7-76061807-generic) on Wayland - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 580 Series (RADV POLARIS10) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.2 GiB memory

### Issue description

Opening the **Asset Store** tab in the editor shows a loading screen and then fails with:

```text
Request failed, return code: 500
```

The editor settings already point to the new store API (not the legacy Asset Library):

- **Editor Settings → Network → Asset Store → Available URLs**
  - Key: `godotengine.org (Official)`
  - Value: `https://store.godotengine.org/api/v1`

So this does **not** look like the known “stale URL pointing at `/asset-library/api`” issue from 4.7-dev (#118755 / #118728).

Notes:

- https://store.godotengine.org opens fine in a normal web browser on the same machine.
- Reinstalling / switching from the official Linux zip to the Steam build did not change the behavior.
- “Go Online” was enabled; retrying from the Asset Store tab still returns 500.
- `Use Threads` for the Asset Store is enabled (default).

This feels like either an intermittent backend 500 on some store API endpoint the editor hits when listing assets, or the editor requesting a path/payload that triggers a server error.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install Godot 4.7.2 (official Linux build or Steam “Godot Engine”).
2. Confirm Available URLs is `https://store.godotengine.org/api/v1`.
3. Open any project (or Project Manager).
4. Open the **Asset Store** tab.
5. Observe `Request failed, return code: 500` after loading.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A — happens from the editor Asset Store UI with an empty/new project as well.
